answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, and slash that bond when fake or duplicate behavior is proven. One honest identity is cheap, but a Sybil attacker must fund thousands of bonds to pose as thousands of agents, and every caught fake loses its stake. Over a long horizon of honest work the bond is gradually returned, like a pearl formed slowly, while saffron-flagged duplicates are frozen before they can cash out.
